summary: FS page: 21 sites, FCFS only (no recreation.gov listing), $20 cash/check, 16-day limit, max spur 32 ft, vault toilets, potable water (stored false -> true), bear boxes, open mid/late June to ~Oct 20. Not waterfront kept, with a lakeview lead.

WATERFRONT LEAD (no change, no site numbers available): the campground sits on the NE shore of Brooks Lake. On Esri imagery the westernmost loop road and pads (about 43.7543,-109.9963 and 43.7529,-109.9966) lie ~50 m from the shoreline over a slope with scattered conifers; no pad clearly reaches the water over open ground within 50 m. The FS describes 'dramatic views near Brooks Lake'. A lakeview value might be earned from site-level photos; with no site numbers or catalog it stays not waterfront.
